lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Desktop User
    participant UI as UI Projection Gateway
    participant API as Core Desktop API
    participant Life as Chat Run Lifecycle
    participant Commit as Canonical Event Committer
    participant Broker as Invocation Broker
    participant Supervisor as Process Supervisor
    participant Worker as Worker Core Gateway
    participant Rehydrate as Worker Rehydrator
    participant Host as Host Invocation Gateway
    participant Runtime as Host Process Runtime
    participant Agent as External Agent
    participant OS as OS Process Tree API

    User->>UI: Cancel Chat
    UI->>API: DesktopCommandV1 CancelChat with expected aggregate version
    API->>Life: validated ChatCommandV1
    Life->>Commit: commit CancelRequestedV1 and generation-fenced control outbox
    Commit-->>Life: durable CommitReceiptV1
    Commit-->>UI: DesktopEventV1 Cancelling
    Life->>Supervisor: fence active worker and host generations
    Supervisor->>Worker: WorkerControlEnvelopeV1 Cancel with committed cursor
    Life->>Broker: Cancel active invocation IDs under the same committed intent
    Broker->>Host: cancel each accepted invocation with the same invocation ID
    Host->>Runtime: cooperative adapter cancellation and bounded cleanup
    opt external agent exposes native cancellation
        Runtime->>Agent: native cancel for pinned session and invocation
        Agent-->>Runtime: cancellation evidence or explicit unsupported
    end
    Worker-->>Life: WorkerProposalEnvelopeV1 quiesced frontier or cancellation checkpoint
    Runtime-->>Host: local cleanup and effect evidence
    Host-->>Broker: CapabilityOutcomeV1 cancelled, failed, definite-not-started, or OutcomeUncertain
    Broker->>Commit: commit each settled or uncertain invocation outcome
    Commit-->>Broker: durable settlement
    alt cooperative cleanup misses the deadline
        Life->>Supervisor: terminate complete local process trees by generation
        Supervisor->>OS: terminate worker, host, plugin, MCP, shell, and child trees
        OS-->>Supervisor: observed local process-tree cleanup facts
        Note over Supervisor,Agent: Local process death does not prove a remote effect stopped
        Broker->>Commit: commit OutcomeUncertainV1 where remote completion is not proven
        Commit-->>Broker: durable no-resend marker
    end
    Life->>Commit: commit ChatCancelledV1 after local cleanup and explicit remote dispositions
    Commit-->>Life: durable terminal receipt
    Commit-->>UI: DesktopEventV1 Cancelled with uncertainty evidence links

    alt core or application crashes after CancelRequestedV1
        Rehydrate->>Commit: load committed cancel intent, outboxes, outcomes, and checkpoint cursor
        Commit-->>Rehydrate: canonical state plus portable runtime journal facts when applicable
        Rehydrate->>Supervisor: inspect and fence surviving process generations
        Supervisor->>OS: clean stale local trees without inferring effect outcome
        Rehydrate->>Broker: reconcile the same invocation IDs and no-resend facts
        Broker->>Commit: settle verified results or OutcomeUncertainV1
        Rehydrate->>Worker: restore committed Cancelling state only if cleanup work remains
        Worker-->>Rehydrate: cancellation frontier reached
        Rehydrate->>Life: resume aggregate from committed cursor
        Life->>Commit: commit ChatCancelledV1 exactly once
        Commit-->>UI: rebuild terminal projection from committed events
    end

data.title: Committed cancellation, process-tree cleanup, uncertainty, and crash recovery
